subject: english
question:
Select the word that best completes the given sentence. Determine the collocation through the sentence.

The teacher, Sara, told us we must _________ arrangements for the upcoming conference.
solution:
The correct answer is '**make**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**make**" is commonly used to collocate with "arrangements."
 
• The phrase "**make arrangements**" refers to organizing or planning something.
 
• The other options: "**put**," "**made**," and "**meet**" do not form correct collocations with "arrangements."

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The teacher, Sara, told us we must make__ arrangements for the upcoming conference.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Put**: While this verb is correct in many contexts, it does not collocate with "arrangements."
 
• **Made**: This is the past tense of "make," but the sentence uses the modal verb "must" which requires the base form of the verb.
 
• **Meet**: This verb does not fit the context of the sentence as it is unrelated to "arrangements."
